GIS Data Analyst
Boston, MA (Hybrid)
Full-time

About the role
Join a geospatial technology team building data products for public-sector clients.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, geography, or a related field.
- 2+ years of professional data analysis experience.
- Strong Python, SQL, GIS, ArcGIS, and data visualization skills.
- Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
- GISP certification required.

Preferred Skills
- ArcGIS Pro and Tableau.

Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 per year.
